# Sai Vivek Peddi

> Engineer, researcher and co-founder of mlpal (https://mlpal.ai). Grew up in Hyderabad; B.E. BITS Pilani, M.S. CS UC Davis; previously KFintech and JPMorgan Chase. Co-founded mlpal with Dipak Ghosal and Prem Jain. Builds ML systems from GPU kernels to coding agents. co-leads the BITS Alumni Association in the Bay Area as COO (BITSAA Silicon Valley Chapter, instagram.com/bitsaa.svc; 11,000 BITSians). Goes by Sai; close friends call him Peddi. Photographer (Instagram @_forgotten_chornicles). Off the clock: badminton, cricket (all-rounder, Dhoni fan), cooking (dosa, homemade bread), music, books. Based in Mountain View, CA. Contact: svp@mlpal.ai
